description: Use this when the user wants clothing with specific fiber content or an alternative to a brand, for example "leggings like Lululemon without polyester", "Vuori dupes without synthetic fabric", "natural fiber underwear for women", "linen shirts for men with no synthetics" or "polyester-free socks". For a PFAS-free request it can find clothing with no synthetic fibers, but fiber content is not a PFAS test. Returns products Greener Closet has analyzed, highest score first, with their disclosed fiber breakdown. Fiber exclusions only count products whose full composition is disclosed. It doesn't filter by price. Do not use this to check one product or brand (use check_product or check_brand).

excludeAllSynthetics.description: True when the user wants no synthetic fibers at all.

excludeFibers.description: Fibers the products must not contain, e.g. ["polyester", "nylon"]. Recycled versions are excluded too.

minScore.description: Lowest Greener Closet score to include. Defaults to 70.

replaceBrand.description: A brand the user wants an alternative to; its products are excluded.

requireFibers.description: Fibers the products must contain, e.g. ["linen"] or ["merino wool"].

name: find_alternatives
title: Find clothing by fiber content
